scope: End-to-end smoke run of the new workflow on the borrowed GPU machine: reviewed session export -> transfer -> GPU training through run_experiment.py -> checkpoint freeze -> evaluation -> reports back. Not a real training run: 40 tray_v1 photos, 5 epochs.
